evidence.title: shadcn/ui - The Foundation for your Design System
Building Blocks for the Web - shadcn/ui

name: shadcn/ui
summary: Copy-paste React component collection and registry: 60+ accessible components, blocks, charts and a CLI.
description: A collection of accessible React components plus a CLI and registry system to install and distribute code. Components span form and input, layout and navigation, overlays and dialogs, feedback and status, and display (accordion, alert, avatar, badge, button, calendar, card, carousel, chart, checkbox, command palette, data table, date picker, dialog, drawer, dropdown, input, menubar, pagination, popover, progress, select, sidebar, slider, switch, table, tabs, toast, tooltip). Also ships page blocks (dashboard, sidebar, login, signup), charts, markdown typography, and an MCP server.
contains: 60+ components incl. accordion, alert, avatar, badge, button, calendar, card, carousel, chart, checkbox
components incl. command palette, data table, date picker, dialog, drawer, select, sidebar, tabs, toast, tooltip
blocks: dashboard, sidebar, login and signup page sections to copy into apps
CLI commands: init, add, apply, preset, view, search, build, migrate, eject
MCP server to browse, search and install components in AI assistants
theming: colors, dark mode, RTL, components.json config; Typeset markdown CSS
registry system to publish code, with a community registries directory
works with Next.js, Vite, Remix, Astro, Laravel, React Router, TanStack
